description.p: Word Hunter is a language-learning workspace for reading real texts, saving vocabulary with context, and reviewing words later.
It supports imported text, PDFs, EPUB files, subtitles, local vocabulary storage, spaced repetition, text to speech, and optional offline translation models.

screenshot.caption: Reading view with vocabulary highlights and word details

ul.li: Allow complete JSON backups to repair unreadable local text records.
Prevent failed projected-text saves from leaving a blocking recovery journal.
Keep ordinary saves fail-closed so missing book content is never overwritten.
Remove the Android JSON backup export limit and the portable JSON import limit.
Increase Android PDF import and rendering limits to 400 MB.
Replace native Syncthing pairing prompts with an application-styled dialog.
Show busy feedback during JSON and Anki exports and report import progress.
Report exported Anki word counts and skipped Discover duplicates.
Reader word selection no longer re-tokenizes the entire book.
PDF page navigation uses cumulative offsets (O(1) instead of per-page scan).
Rust phrase indexing uses a streaming tokenizer with trie matching.
Index cache fingerprints content instead of sampling for safety.
UI state saves are coalesced into one serialization.
Book body cache pins the active Reader page to avoid eviction.
Library statistics hydration loads and computes stats concurrently.
Edge TTS timeout safety and session isolation fixes.
Request deadlines cover response body reads.
Static assets and media streamed from disk, not fully buffered.
HTTP agent reused globally, not created per request.
Minified frontend bundle with syntax and whitespace compression.
Android starts state loading concurrently with frontend resources.
Flashcard grading rejects duplicate input and falls back after a timeout.
Every grade has feedback sound and new cards can be read automatically.
Due cards are shuffled once per stable review session.
Five recall buttons and Previous/Next stay in single rows on Android.
Flashcard image removal uses a square accessible touch target.
Vocabulary treats case variants (Am/AM/am) as one word across all languages.
Mobile flashcard guidance retires after a few reviews.
Android reader bottom sheet expands only to content height.
Five recall buttons fit on narrow screens.
Ease Factor Distribution graph uses correct bins and includes all EF values.
Desktop image OCR imports JPG, PNG, and WebP via local PaddleOCR.
Make later vocabulary status decisions win reliably across synchronized devices.
Merge notes and translations without restoring stale word statuses.
Reduce Android startup work and bundle the initial JavaScript graph.
Restrict Android cleartext networking to the local Word Hunter backend.
Fix flashcard word and sentence speech so it follows the visible card.
Keep the desktop Word Panel synchronized with keyboard navigation.
Restore spoken-word highlighting for Edge TTS on Windows.
Add and document desktop Reader keyboard shortcuts.
Add exact-word Reader bookmarks and restore the last reading position.
Harden synchronization, backups, imports, and custom-book persistence.
Improve Android synchronization, text-to-speech controls, and conflict resolution.
Add validated Apple Silicon, AppImage, DEB, Snap, AUR, and Nix packaging paths.
Keep Reader playback anchored to the selected word.
Delay the first in-text review of newly learned words until the following day.
Correct Italian interface copy and built-in reader titles.
